title: Towel mod
description: Just a mod that adds an item which allows you to clean!
body:
This is a mod that adds a new item, the towel crafted with 4 carpets (any colour), 4 pieces of string, and 1 water bucket, as shown below.

![The towel crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/400d8e562dc6dbf9738eccedb86ccc07f5309af9.png)

You can use this to right-click on mossy cobblestone, mossy cobblestone stairs, and mossy cobblestone slabs to get moss carpet, which will turn them into their regular cobblestone variants, as long as you're holding the towel.

You can also right-click on gilded blackstone to get a gold nugget, which will turn the gilded blackstone into normal blackstone, as long as you're holding the towel.

If you right-click on crying obsidian, it will turn to obsidian, and you will get a new item, the ender tear, as long as you're holding the towel.

The ender tear can be used to craft the INFINIPEARL, a new item that functions as an infinite ender pearl, the crafting recipe of which is shown below.

![The infinipearl crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/edea2092340fe4636c0511e4305590eda2cd6c2a.png)
